powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — Section bands, card borders, decorative dividers — the brand's secondary canvas, used to segment the page into editorial chapters without introducing contrast

slate-bloom.$description: Slate Bloom — Primary action buttons, active states — the single chromatic accent; its low saturation keeps it feeling clinical rather than commercial

warm-ink.$description: Warm Ink — Primary text, hairline borders, card outlines, icon strokes — near-black with a warm undertone that softens the high-contrast text against white

true-black.$description: True Black — Icon fills, occasional heavy borders — used sparingly for graphical weight when maximum contrast is needed

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, text on dark blocks — the dominant canvas, never off-white or cream

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, low-priority labels — only when a softer reading level is needed without leaving the achromatic palette

primary-font.$description: Primary Font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

primary-sans-custom-serif-influenced-gro.$description: Body text, button labels, badge text, list items, card metadata at weight 300 — the light weight is anti-convention for utility text and signals editorial restraint

tertiary-sans.$description: Emphasized body copy, card descriptions — weight 500 lifts importance without breaking the light-typographic system

display-sans.$description: All headlines and section titles at weight 300 with extremely tight leading — the whisper-weight headlines create authority through restraint, not volume

tertiary-font.$description: Tertiary Font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

button-font.$description: Button Font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

heading-font.$description: Heading Font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
